title: Verify: BootScene builds objects from content with none hardcoded
summary: Unit tests for buildScene wiring, cleanup and no-hardcode guard
description: Mock buildScene and the render context; assert BootScene wiring and scan source text for hardcoded ids.
acceptance_criteria: No object or asset id literal in BootScene.ts or renderContext.ts
technical_constraints: Same phaser mock pattern as frontend/tests/bootSceneEffects.test.ts; fs read only of two source files

steps.action: Mock 'phaser' (Scene with events.once = vi.fn, Scenes.Events.SHUTDOWN), '@game/engine/buildScene' (buildScene: vi.fn returning two fake objects with destroy vi.fn and onInteract/sync vi.fn), '@game/engine/buildEffects', '@game/engine/playSceneTransition', '../src/phaser/renderContext'. Call new BootScene().create(); assert buildScene called once with (ctx, sceneSpec imported from '../src/runtime/content'). Capture the SHUTDOWN callback from events.once.mock.calls and invoke it; assert each fake object's destroy was called once.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneBuild.test.ts -t 'build wiring'

steps.action: Read BootScene.ts and renderContext.ts via node:fs readFileSync; for every object id and asset id in sceneSpec.objects assert the source text does not contain the quoted id string.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneBuild.test.ts -t 'no hardcoded'
